$schema_note: Protocol-neutral synthetic vectors for the pre-action-authority <-> work-receipt temporal boundary. Data only: no runtime, no product dependency. See docs/pre-action-authority-boundary.md. Origin: modelcontextprotocol/modelcontextprotocol#2498.
invariant: Authority flows forward only. A Phase-2 work receipt may reference a Phase-1 pre-action fact; it may never become one, create root authority, certify the effect, or upgrade a tier.

vectors.why: Phase-1 fact bound to the exact normalized call and consumed at dispatch; the Phase-2 work receipt only references it as post-work evidence.

vectors.detail: A workReceiptId (minted after completion) is presented as the pre-action authorization input. A post-work artifact cannot authorize an earlier dispatch.
The executed call's normalizedCallDigest does not match the digest the pre-action authority was bound to; the prior authorization no longer applies to the mutated call.
A pre-action fact whose replayState is already 'spent' (or past expiry) is reused for a second dispatch.
A workReceiptId is used to raise the trust tier of the authority it descends from. Post-work evidence cannot promote the pre-action authority that preceded it.
